query: SELECT ?celestialBody ?celestialBodyLabel ?orbitedBody ?orbitedBodyLabel WHERE { { ?celestialBody wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q634; wdt:P398 ?orbitedBody. } UNION { ?celestialBody wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q3559; wdt:P397 ?orbitedBody. } UNION { ?celestialBody wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q3863; wdt:P398 ?orbitedBody. } UNION { ?celestialBody wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q462; wdt:P397 ?orbitedBody. } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en,de". } } LIMIT 100
